decision.explanation: Both awards are explicitly stated in the provided documents as having been received by Manuel Estrada Pérez. Document D1S2 confirms the Medal of Francysk Skaryna from Belarus, while D2S2 confirms the Knight of the Order of the White Rose of Finland from Finland. The audits confirm direct support for both claims without contradiction in the context of the same referent.
